rows.name: Mon Cha Cha Milk Tea
rows.notes: The Marketspread vendor page for Mon cha cha milk tea (Kailua Farmers Market) links an Instagram account. The handle matches the name and the Oʻahu schedule. The IG bio lists a Downtown HNL shop at 1150 Bishop St (Tue–Fri 9:30–3:30) and markets Wed/Thu 4–7 and Sat/Sun 8–12, but the snippet is undated. I did not find the vendor on the HFBF Kailua list in my results. I could not confirm it is still active, so that is null. No Facebook or website found.

rows.name: Poke Creations
rows.notes: The HFBF Kailua Farmers' Market page lists Poke Creations with the handle @pokecreationshawaii. The IG bio lists a weekly route that includes Thu 'UH Manoa/Kailua' and Sat KCC Market. The HFBF page was indexed about 73 days ago, which is the basis for still_active. No Facebook or website found.

rows.name: Sugah Papi Farms
rows.notes: The HFBF Kailua page lists @sugahpapifarms. The business's own site says it sells farm-grown cut fruit. It lists Saturdays 8am–12pm at 919 Ala Moana Blvd (Honolulu), Sundays 8am–12pm at 604 Ulukahiki St in Kailua (labelled Kailua Farmers Market), and a food truck at 55621 Kamehameha Hwy, Haleiwa. HFBF still lists the Thursday Kailua Farmers' Market. HFBF's text says 'Wailua' for the farm, but its own page says Waialua (north shore) and Marketspread also says Waialua. Trays and platters are by inquiry. No Facebook found.

rows.name: The Corner Rolls
rows.notes: The HFBF vendor page gives both the website and @the.corner.rolls, and Honolulu Magazine also gives @the.corner.rolls. Hawaii News Now (Feb 2026) places them at the Kakaako, Kailua Town and KCC farmers markets. The order.online page is an ordering page for The Corner Rolls at 174 N King St and its opening date is unclear. I did not verify that the IG account posts a weekly schedule, so the HFBF page is used as the schedule source. No Facebook found.

rows.name: Vilath Farm
rows.notes: Only organizer listings were found. The HFBF Kailua and Mililani pages both list it, indexed about 73–74 days ago. The vendor page lists Thursday Kailua, Saturday KCC and Sunday Mililani. I found no Instagram, Facebook or website of its own, and I did not guess handles. Confidence is high only for the organizer listing.

rows.name: Mochi Aulelei Hawaii
rows.notes: The IG bio matches the products (deep-fried poi, coconut and ube mochi). It lists Wed NBC 4–7pm, Thu Kailua 4–7pm, Sat KCC 8–11am and Sat Kaka'ako 8–12pm, but the snippet is undated. The HFBF page was indexed about 386 days ago. There is a Facebook page named 'Mochi Aulelei', but its listed event is the St. George Farmers Market at Vernon Worthen Park, which is not on Oʻahu as far as I can tell. I did not claim it. still_active is null because I could not confirm recent activity.

rows.name: Lanikai Mochi
rows.notes: The HFBF vendor page gives the website and @lanikai_mochi, and lists Thursday Kailua and Saturday KCC. That page was indexed about 286 days ago. It is also named in a Kaka'ako farmers market guide. I did not open the IG or website to confirm they post a schedule. No Facebook found.

rows.name: Nosh
rows.notes: The HFBF page for Nosh LLC gives noshhawaii.com and lists Thursday Kailua and Saturday KCC. The IG and Facebook handles come from a 2016 Honolulu Magazine article (@nosh_hawaii, facebook.com/noshhawaii) and I did not confirm the accounts are live. HAWAIʻI Magazine (about 246 days before today) recommends Nosh's pão de queijo at the Kailua Farmers Market, which supports still_active. The site mentions pop-ups, bake-at-home rolls and restaurant locations.

rows.name: The Pig and the Lady
rows.notes: The business's own market schedule page lists Wednesdays at Neal Blaisdell Center ('stay tuned'), Thursdays at Kailua Farmers Market 4–7, and Saturdays at KCC 7:30–11. The Facebook page is the one posting Kailua market notices. The IG handle comes from the business's Facebook post, which mentions @pigandthelady, and I did not open the IG page. The restaurant is at 83 N. King St, Honolulu. A 2016 post mentions ChowNow ordering, but I found no current order URL.

rows.name: Andy's Bueno Salsa
rows.notes: The HFBF Kailua page (indexed about 73 days ago) lists Andy's under the name 'Bueno Salsa' and describes handmade salsas and pickles, including Kailua-grown ghost pepper recipes. Honolulu Magazine's market guide (about 19 days ago) also lists the vendor. The site's 'Where to Find Us' page shows no upcoming events, so I used the organizer page for the schedule. The Facebook page and site are the business's own (Kailua, PO Box 1320). No Instagram found.

rows.name: Burgers & Burritos Hawai‘i
rows.notes: The HFBF Kailua page lists it as 'Burgers & Burritos Hawaii (BBHI)' with the website above. Honolulu Magazine's market guide (about 19 days ago) lists it under the Hawai‘i spelling used in the seed. Marketspread lists it under the legal name Beyond Burgers Hawaii LLC, with stops at KCC, Honolulu and Kailua. No Instagram or Facebook found.

rows.name: Mochi Lab
rows.notes: The Facebook page (undated) lists Wed Blaisdell 4–7pm and Thu Kailua 5–7:30pm, plus catering and custom orders, and gives mochilab808.com. A Honolulu Magazine mochi guide (about 974 days old) labels Mochi Lab 'CLOSED'. The two sources conflict, and the closure article is old, so treat still_active=false as probable but unconfirmed. Re-check before using. No Instagram found.

rows.name: Omao Man
rows.notes: The IG account is 'Omao Man Hawaii' (Oahu's original green since 2013). Its bio lists Saturday Kaka'ako and Sunday Castle (Kailua). HAWAIʻI Magazine (about 246 days ago) recommends the green smoothies at the Sunday KailuaTown Farmers Market next to Adventist Health Castle, spelled ʻŌmaʻo Man. The seed says Kailua, but this is the Sunday KailuaTown market at Castle, not the Thursday HFBF market. No Facebook or website found.

rows.name: The Vegan Cheese Shoppe
rows.notes: The business's own site and online shop are live, and it is listed on the state Hawaiʻi Made directory. Its Facebook page (undated snippet) mentions a break and a return to FarmLovers Markets, which is where it posts market notices. HAWAIʻI Magazine (about 246 days ago) lists it at the Sunday KailuaTown market. I found no Instagram.

rows.name: Leftover Love Co.
rows.notes: I ran out of searches before I could look this vendor up. All fields are null, and none should be read as evidence the business has no presence. Next step: search for the name together with Waimānalo, composting and KailuaTown Farmers Market (FarmLovers).
